info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Legal Compliance Status-spec
info.description: The Legal Compliance Status API provides an overview of the legal compliance status for enterprises utilizing banking services. It enables businesses to access critical information about their compliance with relevant legal requirements, assisting in risk management and ensuring regulatory adherence. Typical consumers include compliance officers, legal teams, and business analysts who need real-time insights into compliance status to make informed decisions. This API serves as a key resource for maintaining organizational compliance and enhancing operational transparency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of legal compliance for enterprise services. It provides insights into compliance metrics and any pending issues that need attention.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the legal compliance status of enterprise services. This body is used to specify any relevant parameters or filters when querying the current compliance status.

ListLegalComplianceStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the operations related to legal compliance status. It is expected to be a string that conveys specific information about the compliance status.
